newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks fall, led by Staburadze.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks fall, led by Staburadze.

text.p: Latvian shares eased on Thursday, with the falls led by confectionery maker Staburadze as market turnover also fell by half.
Total turnover was 197,461 lats as Staburadze fell 41 santimes or 14 percent to 2.34 lats. It was the largest faller and turned over 14,623 lats.
Unibanka was stable at 3.20 lats and traded 52,934 lats while Riga Transport Fleet was also unchanged at 1.60 lats.
The secondary market shares Daugavpils Chain and Salacgriva Fish cannery were also active as they turned over 38,195 lats and 32,178 lats respectively.
Daugavpils slipped one santime to 2.09 lats and Salacgriva gained five santimes to close at 4.55 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary market trading was dull except for Kaija fish cannery which saw its shares worth 29,688 lats change hands as it gained six santimes to 1.96 lats.
